purr.about: Purr owns none of this. Each line is a schedule some plugin asked the shell to run, and the shell keeps running it while the window is closed. A stopped watch failed on a pass; the tray dot and the notification centre said so at the time.
purr.description: Says what Meows is watching, when it last looked, and which watch quietly stopped.
purr.empty: Nothing is being watched. A plugin that watches something registers it here the moment it is switched on: Collar's dates, Birdwatch's refresh, Saucer's clipboard.
purr.since: This tab has been open since {0}, {1}.
purr.stopped.hint: A watch that stopped will not start again until its plugin is switched off and on. The reason is in the log.
purr.title: Purr
